notes:
App:
• Beta: this update changes how the cabin is drawn. If something looks wrong, please tell us on Discord.
• Improved: The Cabin app and its video player run below the simulator's priority, so they no longer take time from MSFS.
• Improved: Video frames are only prepared for screens that are actually watching.
• Improved: Less background work while flying: fewer folder scans, fewer checks, and the video player stays ready for 10 minutes.
A350 and 777:
• New: Screen quality setting (Auto, Low, Normal, Sharp); Auto picks Low on graphics cards with 8 GB or less.
• Improved: Seat screens use much less graphics memory: each screen now runs once instead of twice where the cabin was attached twice.
• Improved: Paused, loading or ended videos fetch one picture a second instead of 25.
• Improved: Screens release the night-time city lights on the map, and the last video frames, when they are not shown.
• Improved: Cards and buttons have crisp edges instead of soft shadows, which are lighter on the graphics card.
• Improved: Small text is larger and brighter, easier to read from the seat.
• Improved: Thicker progress bars on the home page and in films.
• Improved: The cabin loads faster: the map's list of towns is built about 40 times quicker.
• Fixed: A film no longer stops for good after the safety demonstration; films and YouTube now pause during it and carry on afterwards.
• Fixed: Seat screens no longer stay black after a cabin zone is switched off and on again.
• Fixed: A paused or closed video no longer keeps loading frames in the background.
A350:
• Improved: Window shades draw at half the cost; the handle keeps its darker colour.
• Improved: Cabin LED strips draw as 2 parts instead of 22 (1 instead of 11 on the ULR).
• Improved: ULR seat screens draw as 2 parts instead of 103.
• Improved: The cabin glow fade is worked out once per frame instead of in every cabin part.
777:
• Improved: Seat screens are sharper for the same memory: the screen texture is packed tighter.
• Fixed: The cabin is no longer dark at night at the gate: boarding is in full light, and the evening and night dim scenes are brighter.
